observations.finding: Android Kotlin unit-test compile classpath does not expose java.awt BufferedImage for a custom SnapshotHandler
observations.resolution: Use the framework HtmlReportWriter and export exactly its reported native snapshot

observations.finding: LocalInspectionMode and View.isInEditMode are separate guards; upstream theme casts LocalView.context to Activity outside edit mode
observations.resolution: Declare explicit Preview/LocalView environment in test host; preserve upstream production theme; test real Activity separately
